newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona cargo traffic 13.6 pct higher in January.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona cargo traffic 13.6 pct higher in January.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport in January rose to 6,037 tonnes or up 13.6 percent compared with the same month in 1996, the airport authority said.

European Union freight business rose 9.9 percent to 2,830 tonnes while domestic cargo was down 0.8 percent at 2,137 tonnes. Non European Union international freight business rose 23.1 percent but still accounted for only 724 tonnes of the total.

Passenger numbers were 12.0 percent higher in January at 913,506 excluding transit passengers, thanks largely to a 16.1 percent increase in intra-European Union passenger traffic to 286,733. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
